rows.ca_value: Under new Section 5.15, if Total Revolving Extensions of Credit exceed $450,000,000 at any time, the Borrowers must deposit and maintain USD Cash Collateral of at least the Minimum Collateral Amount ($50,000,000 for Section 5.15). It is held in a segregated account at Citibank, N.A. under Agent control and earns no interest. The Borrowers must top up any shortfall promptly on the Agent's demand (Section 5.15(b)). The deposit is also a condition precedent to any credit event that takes exposure above $450m (Section 4.02(c)) and a Borrowing Limit (Section 2.01(e)). Release: on request, within 2 Business Days, once there is no Default or Event of Default and exposure has been below $450m for 3 consecutive Business Days. The account and control agreement must be in place by the earlier of 45 days after the Amendment No. 4 Effective Date (or a later date the Agent agrees) and any Borrowing Request above $450m. The definition of Total Liquidity expressly excludes Specified Cash Collateral, so the posted $50m does not count toward the minimum liquidity covenant.
rows.ca_quote: exceed $450,000,000, the Borrowers shall deposit and maintain Cash Collateral in United States Dollars in an amount not less than the applicable Minimum Collateral Amount
rows.ca_location: Exhibit A Section 5.15(a)-(d), PDF pp165-166; "Minimum Collateral Amount", PDF p72; "Specified Cash Collateral Release Trigger Event", PDF p88; "Total Liquidity", PDF p93; Section 4.02(c), PDF p152; Section 2.01(e), PDF p105
rows.explanation: The $50m amount and $450m threshold match. The CA fills in the release conditions the TS left open, as well as mechanics the TS left to the Agent's satisfaction. The CA terms are somewhat broader than a pure borrowing condition: the collateral must be maintained whenever exposure exceeds $450m (including through FX revaluation), with a top-up on demand; breach triggers mandatory prepayment through Borrowing Limit (e); the account must be set up within 45 days regardless of usage; and the collateral earns no interest. The CA also excludes the posted collateral from Total Liquidity. This fits the TS footnote, which counts only unrestricted cash as Liquidity, but it means posting the $50m reduces covenant liquidity. The TS's 'Total Revolving Credit Exposure' is called 'Total Revolving Extensions of Credit' in the CA.

document_notes:
TS: not a formal term sheet. It is two undated slides (deck pages 7-8) from a Fluence Energy, Inc. presentation titled "Proposed Terms for Secured Revolving Credit Facility" (footer "PRIVILEGED AND CONFIDENTIAL © Fluence Energy, Inc."). Each slide compares "Existing Terms" with "Proposed Terms", so it is an amendment proposal. PDF p1 covers the commercial terms: Borrower, Guarantors, Security, Facility, LC Sublimit, Incremental, Maturity, Currencies, Pricing, SOFR Floor and Consent Fee. PDF p2 covers RP/RDP, debt and investment baskets, other amendments and the financial covenant; these belong to the covenant groups, not group A. The pdftotext extraction interleaves the two-column table, so the label-to-value mapping was rebuilt from the order of the rows. The quotes are the clean contiguous fragments in the text file. The PDF could not be rendered in this review because pdftoppm is not installed, so the slide image was not re-checked. CA: Amendment Number Four to Syndicated Facility Agreement, dated March 31, 2026 (PDF pp1-26), among Fluence Energy, LLC and Fluence Energy Global Production Operation, LLC (Borrowers), Fluence Energy, Inc. (Parent), the Guarantors, the Lenders and Citibank, N.A. (Agent). It is followed by Schedule I (post-closing perfection, PDF pp27-28) and Exhibit A (PDF p29 onward). Exhibit A is a conformed copy of the Syndicated Facility Agreement dated November 22, 2023, as amended by Amendments 1-4. The reconciliation is against the agreement as amended. In the conformed copy, deleted and added text run together in the extraction (e.g. "December 31, 20252026", "Section 5.15 [Reserved]Specified Cash Collateral Requirement"). Where this happens, the later (double-underlined) text was treated as operative. Limitations: (1) The CA schedules and exhibits are not attached. Schedule 2.01 is missing, so per-lender Commitments, LC Commitments and Borrowing Sublimits cannot be checked; only the $500,000,000 aggregate is stated in the body. (2) The fee letters are not included: the Administrative Agent Fee Letter, the Lender Fee Letter, and any Amendment No. 4 consent fee letter. The 10 bps consent fee therefore cannot be verified. (3) Execution observation: the lender signature pages at PDF pp18-26 (Barclays, Morgan Stanley, RBC, JPMorgan, Wells Fargo, BNP Paribas, HSBC, Mizuho, Goldman Sachs) are captioned "[Signature page to Amendment Number Three to Syndicated Facility Agreement]". The Loan Party, Citibank (Agent and Lender) and Citicorp North America pages (PDF pp6-17) are captioned Amendment Number Four. This should be checked with counsel because Section 3(a) requires Required Lender signatures. (4) Amendment No. 4 also moves the defined "Trigger Date" from the annual (Section 5.01(a)) financial statements for the period ending December 31, 2025 to those for December 31, 2026. It also rolls the Section 6.10 covenant step-down dates by one year (December 31, 2026 and January 1, 2027), in line with the TS. The TS does not state the Trigger Date move expressly; see row A06. (5) Review result: every row's quotes were checked mechanically and appear verbatim in the source files, and all page references were confirmed against the [PDF PAGE] markers. The only change was to make row X01 more complete: it now notes that Specified Cash Collateral is excluded from Total Liquidity, adds the top-up obligation and notes that the Agent can extend the 45-day account deadline. No economic TS term in group A was left unreconciled.

TERM SHEET: this is not a formal term sheet. It is two Fluence Energy lender-presentation slides (deck pages 7-8, "Proposed Terms for Secured Revolving Credit Facility" and "(cont'd)", marked PRIVILEGED AND CONFIDENTIAL). The slides are undated and show "Existing Terms" against "Proposed Terms" for an amendment to the $500MM senior secured revolver. In the pdftotext layout the row labels and the two value columns are interleaved, so the TS text file is garbled. The TS PDF could not be rendered in this environment (pdftoppm is not installed). The row mapping was therefore inferred from the order of the value columns. Slide 7 has 11 labels (Borrower, Guarantors, Security, Facility, LC Sublimit, Incremental, Maturity, Currencies, Pricing, SOFR Floor, Consent Fee) and 11 existing-term values in that order, with Borrower taking two entity lines. The Proposed column has 10 entries in order, Consent Fee having none.
